summary.productGoal: Automate end-to-end recruitment pipeline with AI-powered screening, scheduling, interview, and grading under HR Manager oversight
summary.coreProblem: Manual recruitment process does not scale at >200 jobs/month

in.item: Candidate/Job data import (Excel batch, manual, Google Drive trigger)
AI-powered CV screening with scoring and explainability
Automated interview scheduling via Google Calendar
AI async interview (text chat, hybrid questions)
Candidate state machine and pipeline automation

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow HR Recruiter to import candidate data in batch from Excel (.xlsx) files
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid Excel file, When HR uploads, Then all valid rows imported as IMPORTED within 60s

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow HR Recruiter to manually create job and candidate records via form input
acceptanceCriteria: Given HR fills required fields, When submitted, Then record created and visible

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall automatically import files from configured Google Drive folder when new files detected
acceptanceCriteria: Given watch folder configured, When new file appears, Then imported within 5 min and HR notified

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support JD input as direct text entry or PDF/DOCX file upload
functionalRequirements.rationale: JD is core input for screening
acceptanceCriteria: Given JD provided, When saved, Then parseable and available for screening

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall validate imported files and report errors without blocking valid entries
acceptanceCriteria: Given Excel with invalid rows, When imported, Then valid rows succeed, invalid listed with reasons

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall detect and flag duplicate candidates during import
acceptanceCriteria: Given duplicate email/phone, When importing, Then flag for HR review

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall extract text content from CV files (PDF, DOCX)
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid CV, When processing, Then full text extracted within 5s

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall use AI to match CV against JD and produce matching score (0-100)
acceptanceCriteria: Given CV and JD, When screening, Then score 0-100 within 30s

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate summary of candidate strengths and weaknesses relative to JD
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening done, Then 3-5 strengths and 3-5 weaknesses listed

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall identify and flag critical risk factors in candidate profile
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening done, Then risk flags listed

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall list JD-required skills missing from CV
acceptanceCriteria: Given screening done, Then missing skills enumerated with importance

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall apply configurable matching weights (default: Skills 40%, Experience 30%, Language 20%, Education 10%)
acceptanceCriteria: Given custom weights, When screening, Then scoring uses those weights

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support bulk screening of multiple CVs against one JD
acceptanceCriteria: Given 50 CVs, When bulk screen, Then all processed

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall present screening results to HR Manager for approval
acceptanceCriteria: Given results ready, When HR Manager views, Then can approve/reject individually or bulk

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall handle unreadable/corrupted CV files gracefully
acceptanceCriteria: Given corrupted file, Then mark ERROR, do not block others

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall collect candidate availability via email form/link
acceptanceCriteria: Given approved candidate, When request sent, Then candidate can select slots

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall read interviewer free/busy from Google Calendar
acceptanceCriteria: Given GCal connected, When checking, Then free/busy read accurately

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall suggest optimal interview slots based on availability
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Given availability data, Then suggest top 3 slots (earliest first, 30min buffer, within working hours 9-18 local timezone)

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall require HR Manager approval before confirming schedule
acceptanceCriteria: Given suggested slots, When approved, Then proceed; if rejected, re-suggest

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall create Google Calendar events upon schedule approval
acceptanceCriteria: Given approved slot, Then GCal event created with all participants

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send confirmation emails via shared HR mailbox
acceptanceCriteria: Given confirmed, Then emails sent from hr@company.com

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send interview reminder emails
acceptanceCriteria: Given confirmed interview, When reminder time, Then email sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support multi-timezone scheduling
acceptanceCriteria: Given different TZs, Then correct local time shown

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate unique interview link per candidate
acceptanceCriteria: Given candidate ready, Then unique URL generated

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send interview invitation with link and 72h deadline
acceptanceCriteria: Given link generated, Then email sent with instructions

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall present 5-7 fixed interview questions per job
acceptanceCriteria: Given interview started, Then fixed questions shown sequentially

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate 2-3 AI follow-up questions based on answers
acceptanceCriteria: Given answer submitted, Then contextual follow-up generated

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support interview in Vietnamese, Japanese, and English
acceptanceCriteria: Given JD language, Then interview in matching language

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow async text answers within 72h deadline
acceptanceCriteria: Given link, Then progress saved across sessions, deadline enforced

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall use AI to evaluate responses and generate assessment report
acceptanceCriteria: Given all answers, Then report with score, strengths, concerns, recommendation

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send reminder if interview not completed within 48h
acceptanceCriteria: Given 48h passed, Then reminder email sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall allow test import from Excel/JSON with questions and answer keys
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid file, Then test available for assignment

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send test assignment to candidate via email with link
acceptanceCriteria: Given TEST_PENDING, Then email sent with link and deadline

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall auto-grade MCQ against answer key with 100% accuracy
acceptanceCriteria: Given MCQ submission, Then score matches key exactly

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall use AI to grade essays based on rubric (0-100)
acceptanceCriteria: Given essay + rubric, Then score 0-100 with justification

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall grade coding challenges via test cases and AI code quality review
acceptanceCriteria: Given code submission, Then test pass rate + quality score + feedback

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall generate consolidated test report with scores and pass/fail
acceptanceCriteria: Given all graded, Then report with section scores, total, pass/fail

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support configurable pass threshold per job (default 60%)
acceptanceCriteria: Given threshold set, Then pass/fail determined accordingly

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall auto-transition candidate state except at approval points
acceptanceCriteria: Given auto-transition state, When condition met, Then advances automatically

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall require HR Manager approval at screening and scheduling stages
acceptanceCriteria: Given approval point reached, Then pipeline pauses, notification sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support bulk approval
acceptanceCriteria: Given multiple pending, Then batch approve/reject in one action

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send reminder after 24h if approval pending
acceptanceCriteria: Given >24h pending, Then reminder sent

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall never auto-cancel or auto-skip pending approvals
acceptanceCriteria: Given indefinite pending, Then only reminders, no auto-action

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall track and display candidate state throughout pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Given any candidate, Then current state and history visible on dashboard

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support candidate withdrawal at any stage
acceptanceCriteria: Given withdrawal, Then state=WITHDRAWN, pipeline stops, stakeholders notified

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall send all candidate emails from shared HR mailbox
acceptanceCriteria: Given any candidate email, Then from=shared HR mailbox

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall support configurable email templates
acceptanceCriteria: Given template configured, Then used with dynamic fields

functionalRequirements.statement: The system shall notify HR Manager of pending actions
acceptanceCriteria: Given action required, Then notification within 1 min

integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Retry with backoff; alert after 3 failures
Queue and retry; alert on failure

integrationRequirements.purpose: CV screening, interview evaluation, test grading; content generation only in Phase 2
integrationRequirements.failureExpectation: Retry with backoff; queue if rate limited; route sustained failures or schema-invalid outputs to manual review

constraints.constraint: CV format: PDF and DOCX only

constraints.impact: Pipeline can stall at approval points
All 5 stages must work at launch

conflicts.conflict: No timeout may stall pipeline at scale
conflicts.decision: Accepted: reminder-only is business decision. Monitor queue depth.

checks.notes: Use-case, state machine, approval, AI result, integration, and file/OCR contracts added as handoff prerequisites

validation.decision: Accepted for discovery and BA refinement; hold for solution design sign-off and development handoff until P0 contract gaps are resolved.

openQuestions.question: AI matching weights confirmed by business?
Coding test sandbox: in-browser or external?
Exact fixed interview question count (5 or 7)?
Google Drive watch folder path and naming convention?
What exact confidence threshold routes AI results to manual review?
Who is backup approver for escalation?
What is the Google Drive folder ownership and webhook renewal responsibility?
What is the Calendar reschedule/cancel policy after event creation?
What coding sandbox/runtime is approved for code execution?
What retention/deletion period applies to CVs, transcripts, and test submissions?

useCaseContracts.name: Candidate Sourcing
useCaseContracts.trigger: Manual form, Excel upload, or Google Drive watch file
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: Successful import sets state IMPORTED; invalid/duplicate records require review or ERROR

useCaseContracts.name: Interview Scheduling
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: AVAILABILITY_PENDING -> SCHEDULING_PENDING_APPROVAL -> INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED only after approval

useCaseContracts.name: AI Interview
useCaseContracts.trigger: Interview scheduled or AI interview stage reached
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: AI_INTERVIEW_PENDING -> AI_INTERVIEW_COMPLETED; incomplete/expired sessions require reopen or manual decision

useCaseContracts.name: Test Grading
useCaseContracts.trigger: Candidate completes interview and test is assigned
useCaseContracts.approvalStateContract: TEST_PENDING -> TEST_GRADED -> FINAL_REVIEW; HR Manager can override with reason

approvalMatrix.escalation: 48h to backup HR Manager if configured
24h to backup HR Manager if configured
approvalMatrix.automationRule: Never create Calendar event before approval

approvalMatrix.escalation: 72h to backup HR Manager if configured
approvalMatrix.automationRule: Never mark PASSED/FAILED solely from AI

approvalMatrix.escalation: Admin review for persistent technical failure

aiQualityMetrics.target: Human reviewer agreement >= 80% on validation dataset
False reject sample review performed monthly
No release if prompt/rubric score drift exceeds agreed threshold
100% low-confidence outputs route to manual review

fileOcrBoundary.cv: Text-native PDF and DOCX only; scanned/image-only files rejected in MVP
fileOcrBoundary.jd: Direct text, text-native PDF, and DOCX only; scanned/image-only files rejected in MVP
fileOcrBoundary.parseConfidence: Low-confidence extraction routes to manual review
